coverage: Amtrak passenger routes in this FRA/BTS NTAD snapshot only; not all US freight, commuter, regional or urban rail. Provider description of 50 states/DC is not proof of service in each state. Geometry includes Canadian portions; no US-boundary clipping.

source.datasetDescription: The Amtrak Routes dataset updated May 12, 2026 from the Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). This dataset is a single line representation of unique routes that are generated from the North American Railroad Network (Amtrak). It contains a geographic reference of the Amtrak system at 1:24,000 or better and the dataset covers all 50 states and the District of Columbia. A data dictionary, or other source of attribute information, is accessible at https://doi.org/10.21949/1529009

lengthMethod: WGS84 ellipsoid Vincenty inverse, sum of consecutive vertices WITHIN each source path; shared alignments across routes are counted per route
componentMethod: componentCount counts ride trails: join only exact source endpoints at degree-2 vertices; split at gaps and branches; connectedGroupCount counts shared-source-vertex connectivity
segmentDefinition: Consecutive coordinate pairs inside source paths; sourcePaths counts the preserved ArcGIS paths
routeIdPolicy: ntad-amtrak-{OBJECTID}; source-layer identity, not guaranteed stable across future provider republishing
